notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
If opponents control three or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
